candidates.meaning: Find the producer of the movie 'Inception'.
candidates.sql: SELECT Producer.full_name FROM Producer JOIN Movies ON Producer.producer_id = Movies.producer_id WHERE Movies.title = 'Inception';

candidates.meaning: Find the director of the movie 'Inception' as a possible producer.
candidates.sql: SELECT Director.first_name, Director.last_name FROM Director JOIN MovieDirector ON Director.director_id = MovieDirector.director_id JOIN Movies ON MovieDirector.movie_id = Movies.movie_id WHERE Movies.title = 'Inception';

candidates.meaning: Find the studio that produced the movie 'Inception' as a possible producer.
candidates.sql: SELECT Studio.name FROM Studio JOIN Movies ON Studio.studio_id = Movies.studio_id WHERE Movies.title = 'Inception';
